item.description:
### Fixed
- **An outdated helper is now visible**: after declining the "Outdated Helper Detected" prompt, the menu-bar icon switches to a download arrow and the tooltip reads "Helper update available", instead of the app silently continuing with the old helper - **"Disabled" is no longer reported as successful when the helper is not running**: the daemon owns the persisted config, so the disable could not have stuck — the menu now offers to reconnect instead of claiming success - **Sleep Mode self-heals a dropped wake event**: the 3 s watchdog cross-checks the live power state, so a missed `systemHasPoweredOn` can no longer pin the LED off - **Helper update detection now reads universal (fat) Mac-O binaries correctly**: the previous reader used the wrong `fat_arch` entry stride (16 instead of 20 bytes) and mis-read `fat_arch_64` fields, so any non-thin helper silently fell back to a git-revision comparison - The installer's `wait_for_job_gone` now reports whether the job actually went away rather than always "succeeding" (behaviour is unchanged: callers continue with a warning)
### Changed
- **Night Schedule is dimmed** while the helper is not running or is disabled, since the daemon is what enforces it - The menu-bar icon may briefly show the "waiting for helper" hourglass at launch: helper liveness is now probed off the main thread instead of blocking it - **Release pipeline hardening**: the Sparkle signing key and the VirusTotal key are scoped to the individual steps that use them (previously job-wide, so `swift test`/`swift build` could read them), GitHub Actions are pinned to commit SHAs (with Dependabot keeping them current), and the VirusTotal API key is no longer passed in `curl`'s argv - Install/update failures are now recorded in the unified log (subsystem `com.magsleep.app`) so they can be diagnosed after the fact
### Internal
- The daemon's socket server moved to `MagSleepCore`, and its line-framing and peer-authorization rules were extracted as pure, unit-tested types (`SocketFraming`, `PeerAuthorization`); the suite grew from 95 to 115 tests, including an integration test that drives a real server over a temp-path socket - `SECURITY.md` now documents the threat model and the install-time integrity check's limits

### Fixed
- **About box text was unreadable in Dark Mode**: the dialog body had no explicit foreground color, so the text view fell back to black on the dark alert background. It now uses the dynamic system text color — white in Dark Mode, near-black in Light Mode

### Changed
- **Menu-bar icon while the helper starts**: during the launch grace period the icon now shows the hourglass ("Waiting for helper…") instead of the warning triangle; the triangle is reserved for a helper that is genuinely absent or not running
